svg.title: It remains to justify that equality only on the product tests stated in the theorem would imply equality of these imaginary-time values. Every smooth compactly supported momentum test v can be represented as the relative wave transform of a tensor product of two Schwartz position tests. Choose the first Fourier test equal to one on a ball containing supp v; choose the second by Fourier surjectivity so that the relative product is v. Equivalently one may multiply v by the first Fourier test and its conjugate, whose squared modulus is one on this support.
